description: Procedurally generate a labelled rock-climbing animation dataset (Uncharted / BotW style): UEFN mannequin with Physics Control body and limbs pinned to holds sampled on primitive surfaces, planner explores in set directions with realistic weight distribution; traverse, 3-point hang, hold break, ledge hang, shimmy and ledge break; baked to AnimSequence + sidecar v4 with captions, headless and resumable.
